title: Spicy Energy Balls
description: A tasty Indian-inspired snack made with eggs and spices, perfect for a quick pick-me-up.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, whisk together the eggs, chili powder, garam masala, and salt.
Add the olive oil and mix until well combined.
Gradually add the flour and coconut flakes, mixing until a dough forms.
Use your hands to shape the dough into small energy balls, about 1 inch in diameter.
Place the energy balls onto a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake for 12-15 minutes, or until the energy balls are lightly golden brown.
Remove from the oven and let cool completely on a wire rack.
Store in an airtight container for up to 5 days.
